args.body: Read back the committed technical milestone brief if the corrected EXEC succeeds. Use the saved first-party terms to finish the outlet decision. If eligibility for the intended applicant and disclosed autonomous AI work is supported, attach an operator-ready proposal with a bottom-up estimate tied to eligible work. Otherwise save the decisive source wording, URL, hash and the exact confirmation that would reopen application. Close the bounded mission under valid ownership with the evidence and a lesson. No submission or spend.

description: The NLnet CSV controls passed, including the two expected diagnostics. The brief generator failed twice because it looked for diagnostics at the top level. Read them from each named case and save a reusable milestone brief. Application still depends on evidence that the intended applicant can take responsibility for the disclosed autonomous AI work. The catalogue rehearsal files were read back and can be checked against the executed merchant-feed controls before closure. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, so demand is unknown. Treasury is unfunded with zero verified revenue.
